input.title: ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Art Plan
input.bodyText:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — Art Plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For review Thu Oct 2. Please comment directly in this doc.
Tracker (one row per item, owners and due dates): TRACKER_LINK

1. Goal
Everything players see from Zombie Match 3D looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages on both stores and every ad running on Unity. This plan goes through everything live today (Oct 1) and gives each item one call, an owner and a due date.

2. Sources used
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick) plus the ART ticket comments for capture build, master and campaigns.
- Frederick's Trello comment on the Halloween push card: Julia's 4:5 static (ART-826, "They're coming, stop them!") is still running on iOS UK and is our best CPI there, but is not on the sheet. Counted in.
- ART-831 (Marcus's portrait UA end card, plays after every Android US phone video) is still running per Frederick's Sep 29 ticket comment, also not on the sheet. Counted in.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12) and his changes email (Sep 30). The Sep 30 email wins where they differ.
- Arthur's ZM3D release calendar — Q4.
- Robert's deck "Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025", and his Sep 17 note on the icon.
- Martin's Halloween store exports (Sep 30) and Marcus's Halloween test on cheer fastcouch (Sep 29), both in the ZM3D Halloween 2025 Drive folder.

3. Key dates
- Unity campaigns in the Halloween flight: iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet, Android US phone. Flight runs Sat Oct 18 – Fri Oct 31.
- Android US tablet campaign ends Sun Oct 12 (budget moves to iOS UK), so anything that only runs there gets no Halloween version.
- Every Halloween ad must be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (Unity needs upload + approval before the flight starts). This replaces the Oct 17 date in the Sep 12 draft.
- Proposed internal checkpoint: refreshed (re-captured / re-cut) versions done by Fri Oct 10, so the seasonal pass fits before Oct 15.
- Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween changes. Merge cut Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. New iOS screenshots and the app icon must be in by that cut.
- Apple review up to 3 days: plan on the Halloween build and iOS listing being live from Wed Oct 22.
- Google Play listing graphics are not tied to a build: upload any day, allow 1 day for review.
- Nov 6 submission: icon and screenshots back to normal.

4. Rules applied (Robert's seasonal art direction)
- Seasonal dressing only goes on top of current art. Anything captured or rendered from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone on the current build first. If a later capture has replaced it, the newest capture counts.
- A video whose master has music baked in is re-cut first from a master without music (re-export one if none exists).
- Only the seasonal layer changes: pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment. Same flat background, same pose, same zombie order, same CTA, so each Halloween variant still tests clean against its normal version.
- Calls: Halloween version (dress it from current art) / Refresh first (re-capture, re-render or re-cut, then the seasonal pass) / Reuse (a seasonal version already exists) / Skip (no seasonal version this time).
- Icon (Robert, Sep 17): a Halloween icon must stay as simple as the current one; Martin's Sep 17 draft is nice for an event but too busy at icon size.

5. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. Martin. Final art merged by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT so it ships in the Oct 17 build. New ART ticket: ICON_TICKET.
  On "swap the icon around the 24th": the icon lives in the build, so it can't be swapped on its own date. With the Oct 17 submission it goes live on iOS around Wed Oct 22 (two days before the 24th) and comes out in the Nov 6 build. If we wanted a later swap there is no later Halloween build to carry it. Arthur to confirm Android rollout timing.
- iPhone 6.5" set (App Store): REUSE. Martin's Halloween set is exported (5 shots, Store folder). Attach to the Oct 17 submission by the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut; live from ~Oct 22. Revert with Nov 6.
- iPad 12.9" set (App Store): HALLOWEEN VERSION, new art. No Halloween iPad set exists yet. Martin dresses the live iPad comps with the same seasonal layer as the iPhone set. Due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT (goes with the Oct 17 submission). New ART ticket: IPAD_TICKET.
- Google Play phone set: REUSE. Martin's Halloween set is exported (6 shots, Store folder). Upload by Thu Oct 16 so it clears the 1-day review before the flight starts Oct 18. Can be reverted any day after Oct 31 (not build-tied). Uploader to confirm at review.
Per Leonard (Sep 30, #zombie-art): store art already exported needs no ticket; tickets are only for store art still to be made, so only the icon and iPad set get new tickets.

6. Ads — summary (58 live creatives)
- Halloween version: 11 (Marcus 11).
- Refresh first: 37 (Marcus 31 videos/end cards, Martin 6 Julia statics).
- Reuse: 2 (cheer fastcouch 9:16 ART-808 and 16:9 ART-816 — Marcus's Sep 29 Halloween cuts, made from the no-music #1896 masters).
- Skip: 8 (only run on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12): ART-806, 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844, 849.
All non-skipped ads are due to Frederick Wed Oct 15. Each ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date; tickets needing new work are assigned to the maker.

Halloween version (current art, seasonal pass only) — Marcus:
ART-817 marcus.bennett 16:9, ART-818 marcus.bennett 4:5, ART-819 marcus.bennett 1:1 (Android #1630, no-music masters); ART-833 end card 001, ART-834 end card 16:9 from 001, ART-835 end card 1:1 from 001, ART-848 end card 4:5 from 001 (rendered from #1529, Aug 4); ART-851 cheer fastcouch 4:5 (#1896; can start from the Halloween 9:16 cut); ART-852 barrel marketing2 1:1 (#1896); ART-853 couch alpha 50 4:5 (#1935); ART-854 balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9 (#1966).

Refresh first — Marcus (videos and end cards). Grouped by source capture so one re-capture covers several formats:
- couch boss: ART-793 (9:16), ART-843 (16:9). Android #440.
- couch alpha 30: ART-794 (9:16), ART-802 endcard (also music baked in). Apr 7.
- couch alpha 50: ART-795 (9:16), ART-823 (16:9). Android #456. (The 4:5, ART-853, is already on #1935.)
- balloons alpha 50: ART-796 (9:16, music baked in), ART-797 (1) (9:16), ART-803 endcard. Android #456/#475.
- barrel alpha 30: ART-798 (9:16, music baked in), ART-801 endcard. Apr 7/8.
- couch marketing2: ART-799 30s (music baked in), ART-800 endcard. Android #457/#475.
- balloons marketing2: ART-804 endcard. Apr 8.
- barrel marketing2: ART-805 4:5. Android #633. (The 1:1, ART-852, is already on #1896.)
- cheer 30p: ART-807 9:16, ART-847 4:5. Android #771, music baked in on both.
- marcus.bennett 9:16: ART-809. Capture is current (#1630) but the live master has music baked in; re-cut from Marcus's Aug 13 no-music master, then the seasonal pass.
- squirrelfail: ART-810 portrait, ART-811 landscape. Prototype capture (Dec 2024).
- mrfluffernot: ART-812 portrait, ART-813 landscape. Prototype.
- cinematicTutorial / tutorialCinematic: ART-814, ART-815, ART-845 (16:9), ART-846 (1:1). Prototype.
- boris fastcouch 9:16: ART-840. Jul 28 capture; rebuild on the Sep 16 #1896 fastcouch re-capture, keep the Sep 11 Boris opening.
- boris alin2: ART-841 (9:16), ART-850 (16:9). Android #1427 (Jul 28).
- end card template 16:9: ART-832. Rendered from #456 footage.
- marcus portrait UA end card: ART-831. Rendered from #1450 footage (Jul 29), just before the #1452 swap.

Refresh first — Martin (stills). All of Julia's statics were made from Android #852 captures (Jun 5): re-capture stills on the current build, rebuild each static with the same layout and CTA, then the seasonal pass.
ART-825 julia 1:1, ART-826 julia 4:5 (best iOS UK CPI — prioritise), ART-827 julia 9:16, ART-828 julia 16:9, ART-829 julia 1:1 android 1080, ART-830 julia 4:5 android 1080x1350.

7. Who makes what by when
- Martin: Halloween icon + iPad set by Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT; 6 Julia statics refreshed by Fri Oct 10 and Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Marcus: 31 refreshes by Fri Oct 10 (grouped into ~17 source re-captures/re-cuts above); 11 Halloween versions + Halloween passes on the refreshed cuts to Frederick by Wed Oct 15; hand Frederick the 2 Reuse cuts (cheer fastcouch 9:16 / 16:9).
- Frederick: queue Unity uploads/approvals from Oct 15 for the Oct 18 start; pause the normal versions or run side by side as you prefer.
- Arthur: carry the icon + iOS screenshots (iPhone + iPad) in the Oct 17 submission; revert in Nov 6.
- Robert: approve the icon direction and spot-check the first Halloween ad and first static against the direction.
- Claire: art review on everything before it goes to Frederick; keep the tracker current.

8. Risks / open questions for Thursday
- Marcus's load: 42 video/end-card items, 31 of them refreshes, in two weeks. If that's too much, the fallback is for Frederick to pause the lowest performers in the flight rather than run them undressed. Frederick, can you flag which ones you'd drop first?
- Icon timing: confirm we're fine with the icon going live with the build (~Oct 22 on iOS) rather than the 24th.
- Google Play uploader and Android build rollout timing — Leonard / Arthur to confirm.
- The live creatives sheet is missing ART-826 and ART-831; Frederick may want to add them.
- The Halloween flight campaign list comes from the "still running" ticket comments (most checked Sep 9) plus Frederick's Sep 30 changes. Frederick, flag anything that has been paused since.

input.description:
Halloween version of the Zombie Match 3D app icon for both stores (Halloween 2025 push).

**Direction (Robert):** a Halloween icon must stay as simple as the current one. The Sep 17 draft (AppIconHalloween.png in #zombie-art) is nice for an event but too busy at icon size. Seasonal layer only, per "Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025": same base icon, add a light Halloween touch (e.g. a pumpkin or fog), no extra clutter.

**Due: Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT** — the icon lives in the build, so final art must be merged by the Oct 16 merge cut to ship in the Oct 17 submission (last Halloween build). iOS live ~Wed Oct 22 after review. Reverted in the Nov 6 submission.

Robert to sign off direction before final export. Deliver to the ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store folder.

Halloween art plan + tracker are ready for Thursday :jack_o_lantern: Everyone on the review has comment access.
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/4cbad666e3d89555e3f89ce9/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1V_wQcgWWVjGjPNtb37a_Q0_YckI9wB1120nPtDehl44/edit

**Short version**
• **Ads (58 live, including Julia's 4:5 ART-826 and Marcus's portrait end card ART-831, which aren't on the live sheet):** 11 Halloween version · 37 refresh first (old build or music baked in, per Robert's direction) · 2 reuse (cheer fastcouch 9:16/16:9) · 8 skip (Android US tablet only, which ends Oct 12). Every ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date. The 48 that need new work are assigned (Marcus 42, Martin 6) and all due to Frederick **Wed Oct 15** for the Oct 18–31 flight.
• **Store:** iPhone + GP Halloween sets are already exported (reuse). New tickets for the two pieces still to make, both Martin's, due **Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT** (Oct 17 build): icon <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855|ART-855> · iPad 12.9" set <https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856|ART-856>
• **Icon on the 24th:** the icon ships inside the build, so it can't be swapped on its own date. If it goes in the Oct 17 submission it's live on iOS around Wed Oct 22 and comes out in the Nov 6 build.
• **For Thursday:** Marcus has 31 refreshes in two weeks, so we need to decide what to drop if that's too much. Also need to confirm who uploads the GP set (by Oct 16).
